verdict.rationale: Deel is a payroll platform, so configuring multiple pay schedules is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack contains only general payroll marketing ('run accurate, compliant payroll... across 150+ countries') plus API, sandbox, webhook and MCP material. Nothing documents configurable pay frequencies (weekly, biweekly, semimonthly, monthly) or assigning different schedules to different teams.
